```rust
    pub discdb: Option<&'a DiscDbTitle>,
    /// The text rule's decisions (`crate::subtitle::text::Decision`, from `text::decide`) keyed by scan stream, when OCR text was read.
    pub text: Option<&'a BTreeMap<u32, crate::subtitle::text::Decision>>,
    /// The remembered overrides for this fingerprint (spec 5).
    pub remembered: Option<&'a [SubtitleOverrideEntry]>,
    /// The owner's Override tracks for this title (spec 11), by scan stream; they win over remembered ones. Task 13 passes
    /// `overrides.subtitles_of(title.number)` (that title's entries of `Overrides.subtitles`, by stream).
    pub reviewed: Option<&'a BTreeMap<u32, SubtitleOverride>>,
}

// `SubtitleRole` is `core::tracks::SubtitleRole` (tracks/mod.rs, Task 1), re-exported here.

/// Why a subtitle stream was dropped (8.7, spec 5 and 11 overrides). NoEvents (`no_events`) is a counted stream with no
/// events: MakeMKV removed it as empty (MSG:4047), or 6.4 step 10 measured nothing for it. Def: T9. Use: T10, T13.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case", tag = "why")]
pub enum SubtitleDrop { OtherLanguage, DerivedForcedOnlyEmpty, DerivedForcedOnlyUnused, DirectorsComments, OutsideDialogueGroup, Partial, ExtraDialogueTrack, ExtraForced, ClosedCaptionsUnused, NoEvents, Remembered, Reviewed }

/// 8.7's three alignment bands. Def: T9. Use: T10.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Band { Same, Different, Between }

/// Spec 14's fixed values of 8.7: equal to `text::Rule::default().FULL_SHARE` and `.FORCED_MAX_EVENTS` (pinned by a test;
/// Global Constraints' one-copy rule). Def: T9. Use: T9, T10.
pub const FULL_SHARE: f64 = 0.10;
pub const FORCED_MAX_EVENTS: usize = 150;

/// What 8.7's "Set aside first" takes out of counting, alignment and grouping, and the streams left to count. Def: T9. Use: T10.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct SetAside {
    /// English or no-language derived forced-only streams (flags 4096 and 2048) with their parent (`parent_of`), in scan order.
    pub forced_only: Vec<(u32, Option<u32>)>,
    /// DVD streams flagged 1 or 2 (director's comments): dropped (DirectorsComments). A DVD title is one with attribute 24
    /// (`Title.dvd_title` is Some); a Blu-ray stream flagged 1 or 2 is counted.
    pub directors_comments: Vec<u32>,
    /// The closed-caption stream (codec family ClosedCaptions), when the title has one.
    pub closed_captions: Option<u32>,
    /// Subtitle streams in another language, forced-only ones included (dropped, OtherLanguage), in scan order.
    pub other_language: Vec<u32>,
    /// The English and no-language streams left to count, in scan order (a DVD stream flagged forced, 4096 without 2048, included).
    pub counted: Vec<u32>,
}
/// Spec 8.7 "Set aside first" and its first sentence (other languages dropped). A DVD title is one with attribute 24
/// (`Title.dvd_title` is Some); a Blu-ray stream flagged 1 or 2 is counted. Order of the tests: other language, derived
/// forced-only (even when flagged 1), DVD director's comments, first closed-caption stream, counted. Def: T9. Use: T10.
pub fn set_aside(title: &Title) -> SetAside;
/// The nearest preceding non-derived subtitle stream of the same language; None when there is none (Review Focus 4). Def: T9. Use: T9, T10.
pub fn parent_of(streams: &[&Stream], forced_only: u32) -> Option<u32>;
/// `events >= ceil(FULL_SHARE * largest)`; a track with 0 events is never full. Def: T9. Use: T9, T10, T18.
pub fn is_full(events: usize, largest: usize) -> bool;
/// The larger of align::aligned(a, b, tol) and align::aligned(b, a, tol) (tol = settings.subs_tolerance_s()) against
/// settings.subs_same_min and subs_diff_max. Def: T9. Use: T9, T10, T18.
pub fn band(a: &[f64], b: &[f64], settings: &Settings) -> (f64, Band);
/// Groups of full tracks: two tracks share a group when their band is Same (transitively); Between on any pair sets
/// `ambiguous`; groups in order of their first stream. Def: T9. Use: T10.
pub fn alignment_groups(full: &[(u32, &[f64])], settings: &Settings) -> (Vec<Vec<u32>>, bool);
/// Which of 8.7's picks chose the dialogue group. Def: T9. Use: T10.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum DialoguePick { OneFull, ForcedParent, Described, Largest }
/// Spec 8.7 "Dialogue group", over `groups` (alignment_groups' result): exactly one full track overall (one group of one
/// track) is OneFull; else the group holding a stream of `forced_parents` (the parents of forced-only streams that have
/// events) is ForcedParent; else the group holding a stream whose `described` kinds include Dialogue or Sdh is Described;
/// else the largest group when it has two or more tracks (two or more groups of that size tie and pick nothing: None, so
/// the caller raises subtitle_ambiguous; position never chooses the dialogue group, D15) is Largest; else None (the caller
/// raises subtitle_ambiguous). Forced parents in two or more groups contradict each other: None (subtitle_ambiguous);
/// descriptions in two or more groups name no group, and the largest group is tried. Returns the group's index and the
/// pick. Def: T9. Use: T10.
pub fn dialogue_group(groups: &[Vec<u32>], forced_parents: &[u32], described: &BTreeMap<u32, Vec<DescriptionKind>>) -> Option<(usize, DialoguePick)>;
/// English ("eng" or "en") or no language (lang::is_no_language): the streams 8.7 counts. Spec 8.7. Def: T9. Use: T10, T18.
pub(crate) fn english_or_none(language: Option<&str>) -> bool;
```

Where this task settles what the spec and the interfaces leave open (each choice is pinned by a test below):

1. **Which list a stream falls in.** Every subtitle stream of the title lands in exactly one of `SetAside`'s five lists, tested in this order: a language that is neither English nor no-language puts it in `other_language` (8.7's first sentence, forced-only streams of that language included); then a derived forced-only stream (flags 4096 and 2048) goes to `forced_only`, even when it also carries flag 1; then a director's-comments stream of a DVD title goes to `directors_comments`; then the first closed-caption stream goes to `closed_captions`; everything else is `counted`. A second closed-caption stream (never seen: MakeMKV lists one per DVD title) is counted like any text stream.
2. **What a "DVD stream" is.** `set_aside` sees only the title, so a DVD title is one that carries attribute 24 (`Title.dvd_title`), the DVD title number. In the nine pinned logs and the four recorded scans, attribute 24 is present on exactly the DVD titles (Knowing 7, Firefly 5 and 6, the two Short Circuit DVDs) and on no Blu-ray or UHD title. A Blu-ray subtitle stream flagged 1 or 2 is therefore counted: the spec sets aside DVD streams only.
3. **"Same language" for a parent.** Two codes that both name no language (`lang::is_no_language`: absent, `und`, `zxx`, `mul`, `mis`, `-`, empty) are one language; `eng` and `en` are one language; any other pair is compared through `lang::norm_lang`, so the bibliographic and terminology codes of one language (`fre` and `fra`) are one language. A no-language stream never parents an English one, and an English stream never parents a no-language one.
4. **The full rule is the text rule's comparison.** `is_full` is `events > 0 && events as f64 >= FULL_SHARE * largest as f64`, the form `subtitle::text` uses with its `Rule::default().FULL_SHARE`; for a whole `events` it is the interface's `events >= ceil(FULL_SHARE * largest)`. The 10% lives once, in `subtitle::text::Rule`, with `FULL_SHARE` pinned equal to it (Global Constraints' one-copy rule), so no third copy (a whole percentage) is kept. Tests pin the whole-event answers where a tenth is not a whole number (2.5, 1.1) and check that `is_full` agrees with the text rule's own comparison, through `text::Rule::default().FULL_SHARE`, on every count up to 1,500 events, so the product rule and the text rule never disagree on which track is full.
5. **`band` sorts.** `align::aligned` needs its second list sorted; `band` sorts copies of both lists (`f64::total_cmp`), so a caller's order never changes the answer. The lists `verify::subtitle_events` gives are sorted already.
6. **Forced parents in two groups are ambiguous; split descriptions fall through.** "The one containing the parent" and "the one TheDiscDB describes" name one group. When the forced parents fall in two or more groups, the strongest dialogue evidence the spec has (a forced-only stream with events beside a full track) points at two groups at once: that contradiction is not "none of these picks a group" settled by size, so `dialogue_group` returns None and Task 10 raises `subtitle_ambiguous`, the spec's only fallback. Falling through to the largest group instead would drop full tracks with that evidence as OutsideDialogueGroup at the Alignment confidence of 0.85 and file the title without review. When the described streams fall in two or more groups, the Described pick chooses nothing and the Largest pick is tried: TheDiscDB names English subtitle tracks by their bare language name, which `description_kinds` reads as Dialogue on every English track, so a split there says nothing. A forced parent or a described stream that is in no group (its track is not full) picks nothing. Two or more groups tied at the largest size are not "the largest group": the Largest pick chooses nothing and `dialogue_group` returns None (Task 10 raises `subtitle_ambiguous`), because taking the first in scan order would let disc position decide which full tracks Task 10 drops as OutsideDialogueGroup, a commentary drop (R6), which D15 rules out; Task 10 treats equal counts the same way (its choice 5).
7. **"Events" is Task 12's measurement.** The event start times are counted by `subtitle::align::events` (the one copy), called by Task 12's `verify::subtitle_events` with `sub_clear_max_bytes` for image codecs and 0 for text codecs. This task's code reads no packet; three tests pin the spec's "Events" paragraph through `align::events` at the setting's default and at other values, so the rule the full test counts over is the one the spec states.
8. **Confidence and review reasons.** Spec 8.7's confidence table and its `subtitle_ambiguous` review are Task 10's (`decide_subtitles`): this task returns the facts they come from (`ambiguous` from `alignment_groups`, `None` from `dialogue_group`). No function of this task raises a review reason or a note.

```rust
//! "Set aside first" (with the section's first sentence: every stream in another language is dropped), "Events" (the
//! 10% full rule over the event counts that 6.4 step 10 measures), "Alignment" (the three timing bands and the groups
```

```rust
//! Tests of core::tracks::subtitle, Task 9: design spec 8.7 "Set aside first" (with the section's first sentence),
//! "Events" and the 10% full rule, "Alignment" with its three bands and the groups they make, and "Dialogue group" with
//! each pick in order (Review Focus 4 among them). Scans are built with testsupport::scan_text or read from three of the
//! pinned logs of corpus/thediscdb (Knowing's DVD, Smile's UHD, Firefly's first DVD). Event start times are synthetic:
//! no title recorded in phase 0 has two full English tracks (spec 8.7 "Not yet verified").

use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;

use serde_json::{json, Value};

use super::*;
use crate::disc::{disc, Stream, StreamKind, Title};
use crate::lookup::DescriptionKind;
use crate::recording::files::Packet;
use crate::robot::parse;
use crate::settings::Settings;
use crate::subtitle::align::events;
use crate::subtitle::text::Rule as TextRule;
use crate::testsupport::scan_text;
use crate::tracks::SubtitleRole as TracksRole;

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ fixtures

/// Knowing (2009), DVD: title 0 (2:01:14, DVD title "01") has subtitle streams 4 eng, 5 spa, 6 eng flagged 1, 7 spa
/// flagged 1 (director's comments).
const KNOWING: &str = "movie/Knowing (2009)/2010-dvd/disc01.txt";
/// Smile (2022), UHD: title 12 (0:09:03, 01188.mpls) has two English pairs, 3 and its derived forced-only 4, 21 and its
/// derived forced-only 22 (flags 6144); each English pair is followed by eight other-language pairs (5 to 20, 23 to 38:
/// German, Spanish, two French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Turkish).
const SMILE: &str = "movie/Smile (2022)/2022-4k/disc01.txt";
/// Firefly (2002), DVD 1: title 0 (1:26:26, DVD title "01") has subtitle streams 5 eng, 6 spa, 7 fre flagged 4096,
/// 8 spa flagged 4096, 9 eng closed captions (S_CC608/DVD).
const FIREFLY_1: &str = "series/Firefly (2002)/2003-dvd-the-complete-series/disc01.txt";

/// One title of a pinned TheDiscDB scan log under corpus/thediscdb, typed; the log is read as the corpus test reads it
/// (lossy UTF-8).
fn pinned_title(log: &str, number: u32) -> Title {
    let path = Path::new(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../corpus/thediscdb").join(log);
    let bytes = fs::read(&path).unwrap_or_else(|err| panic!("{}: {err}", path.display()));
    disc(&parse(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes))).unwrap().title(number).unwrap().clone()
}

/// The SINFO attributes of one made-up stream. `kind` is "video", "audio", "pgs", "vobsub" or "cc", with the codec rows
/// of the recordings (AVC video, Dolby Digital stereo audio, HDMV PGS, DVD VobSub, and the DVD closed captions MakeMKV
/// converts to text, attributes 41 and 42); `language` "" writes no attribute 3; `flags` is attribute 22.
fn stream_attrs(kind: &str, language: &str, flags: u32) -> Vec<(u32, String)> {
    let rows: Vec<(u32, &str)> = match kind {
        "video" => vec![(1, "Video"), (5, "V_MPEG4/ISO/AVC"), (6, "Mpeg4"), (7, "Mpeg4 AVC High@L4.1")],
        "audio" => vec![(1, "Audio"), (5, "A_AC3"), (6, "DD"), (7, "Dolby Digital"), (14, "2")],
        "pgs" => vec![(1, "Subtitles"), (5, "S_HDMV/PGS"), (6, "PGS"), (7, "HDMV PGS Subtitles")],
        "vobsub" => vec![(1, "Subtitles"), (5, "S_VOBSUB"), (6, ""), (7, "Dvd Subtitles")],
        "cc" => vec![
            (1, "Subtitles"),
            (5, "S_CC608/DVD"),
            (6, "CC"),
            (7, "Closed Captions"),
            (41, "Text"),
            (42, "( Lossy conversion )"),
        ],
        other => panic!("no made-up stream kind {other}"),
    };
    let mut attrs: Vec<(u32, String)> = rows.into_iter().map(|(id, value)| (id, value.to_string())).collect();
    if !language.is_empty() {
        attrs.push((3, language.to_string()));
    }
    attrs.push((22, flags.to_string()));
    attrs
}

/// Title 0 of a made-up scan, one hour long: a Blu-ray title (attribute 16 "00800.mpls") or, with `dvd`, a DVD title
/// (attribute 24 "01", no attribute 16), holding `streams` as (kind, language, flags), numbered from 0 in that order.
fn title_of(dvd: bool, streams: &[(&str, &str, u32)]) -> Title {
    let owned: Vec<Vec<(u32, String)>> =
        streams.iter().map(|&(kind, language, flags)| stream_attrs(kind, language, flags)).collect();
    let borrowed: Vec<Vec<(u32, &str)>> =
        owned.iter().map(|attrs| attrs.iter().map(|(id, value)| (*id, value.as_str())).collect()).collect();
    let numbered: Vec<(u32, &[(u32, &str)])> =
        borrowed.iter().enumerate().map(|(at, attrs)| (at as u32, attrs.as_slice())).collect();
    let title_attrs: [(u32, &str); 2] =
        if dvd { [(9, "1:00:00"), (24, "01")] } else { [(9, "1:00:00"), (16, "00800.mpls")] };
    let kind = if dvd { "DVD disc" } else { "Blu-ray disc" };
    let text = scan_text(&[(1, kind)], &[(0, &title_attrs[..], &numbered[..])]);
    disc(&parse(&text)).unwrap().title(0).unwrap().clone()
}

/// Ten event starts 10 s apart: 0, 10, 20 and so on up to 90.
fn ten() -> Vec<f64> {
    (0..10u32).map(|k| f64::from(k) * 10.0).collect()
}

/// Ten starts 10 s apart whose first `matching` lie 0.1 s after `ten()`'s and the rest 5 s after: within the default
/// 300 ms of `ten()` exactly `matching` times, so aligned is `matching / 10` in both directions.
fn sharing(matching: u32) -> Vec<f64> {
    (0..10u32).map(|k| f64::from(k) * 10.0 + if k < matching { 0.1 } else { 5.0 }).collect()
}

/// `starts`, each `by` seconds later.
fn shifted(starts: &[f64], by: f64) -> Vec<f64> {
    starts.iter().map(|start| start + by).collect()
}

/// ffprobe's packets of a subs folder (`sub-<n>.packets.json`'s list): start time and size as ffprobe writes them.
fn packets(json: &str) -> Vec<Packet> {
    serde_json::from_str(json).unwrap()
}

#[test]
fn the_fixed_values_equal_the_text_rules_full_share_and_forced_limit() {
    let rule = TextRule::default();
    assert_eq!(FULL_SHARE, 0.10);
    assert_eq!(FULL_SHARE, rule.FULL_SHARE);
    assert_eq!(FORCED_MAX_EVENTS, 150);
    assert_eq!(FORCED_MAX_EVENTS as i64, rule.FORCED_MAX_EVENTS);
}

#[test]
fn every_drop_reason_is_spelled_in_snake_case_under_why() {
    let spelled = [
        (SubtitleDrop::OtherLanguage, "other_language"),
        (SubtitleDrop::DerivedForcedOnlyEmpty, "derived_forced_only_empty"),
        (SubtitleDrop::DerivedForcedOnlyUnused, "derived_forced_only_unused"),
        (SubtitleDrop::DirectorsComments, "directors_comments"),
        (SubtitleDrop::OutsideDialogueGroup, "outside_dialogue_group"),
        (SubtitleDrop::Partial, "partial"),
        (SubtitleDrop::ExtraDialogueTrack, "extra_dialogue_track"),
        (SubtitleDrop::ExtraForced, "extra_forced"),
        (SubtitleDrop::ClosedCaptionsUnused, "closed_captions_unused"),
        (SubtitleDrop::NoEvents, "no_events"),
        (SubtitleDrop::Remembered, "remembered"),
        (SubtitleDrop::Reviewed, "reviewed"),
    ];
    for (reason, text) in spelled {
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(&reason).unwrap(), json!({ "why": text }), "{reason:?}");
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<SubtitleDrop>(json!({ "why": text })).unwrap(), reason);
    }
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<SubtitleDrop>(json!({ "why": "OtherLanguage" })).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn the_bands_are_spelled_same_different_and_between() {
    for (which, text) in [(Band::Same, "same"), (Band::Different, "different"), (Band::Between, "between")] {
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(which).unwrap(), Value::String(text.to_string()));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<Band>(Value::String(text.to_string())).unwrap(), which);
    }
    assert!(serde_json::from_value::<Band>(Value::String("Same".to_string())).is_err());
}

#[test]
fn the_dialogue_picks_are_spelled_in_snake_case() {
    let spelled = [
        (DialoguePick::OneFull, "one_full"),
        (DialoguePick::ForcedParent, "forced_parent"),
        (DialoguePick::Described, "described"),
        (DialoguePick::Largest, "largest"),
    ];
    for (pick, text) in spelled {
        assert_eq!(serde_json::to_value(pick).unwrap(), Value::String(text.to_string()));
        assert_eq!(serde_json::from_value::<DialoguePick>(Value::String(text.to_string())).unwrap(), pick);
    }
}

#[test]
fn default_facts_hold_no_evidence() {
    let facts = SubtitleFacts::default();
    assert!(facts.events.is_empty());
    assert_eq!(facts.removed, BTreeSet::new());
    assert!(facts.discdb.is_none());
    assert!(facts.text.is_none());
    assert!(facts.remembered.is_none());
    assert!(facts.reviewed.is_none());
    let measured = SubtitleFacts { events: BTreeMap::from([(2, vec![1.0, 4.5])]), ..SubtitleFacts::default() };
    assert_ne!(measured, facts);
    assert_eq!(measured.events[&2], vec![1.0, 4.5]);
}
```

```rust
    DirectorsComments,
    /// A full track outside the dialogue group (8.7 "Commentary or trivia", R6).
    OutsideDialogueGroup,
    /// A track that is not full and has FORCED_MAX_EVENTS events or more (8.7 "Other tracks", with the note
    /// partial_subtitle_dropped).
    Partial,
    /// A track of the dialogue group beyond the two 8.7 "Regular and SDH" keeps (D20: two dialogue tracks with the same
    /// dialogue and neither SDH, keep one).
    ExtraDialogueTrack,
    /// A forced candidate after the one 8.7 "Forced" keeps ("Keep at most one").
    ExtraForced,
    /// The closed-caption stream when the dialogue group already has an SDH track (8.7 "Regular and SDH").
    ClosedCaptionsUnused,
    /// A counted stream with no events that 8.7 keeps in no role: MakeMKV removed it as empty (`MSG:4047`), or 6.4 step 10
    /// measured nothing for it (two or more English streams and no evidence). Task 10.
    NoEvents,
    /// A remembered decision dropped it (spec 5).
    Remembered,
    /// The owner's review dropped it (spec 11 "Override tracks").
    Reviewed,
}

/// Spec 8.7's three alignment bands: Same when the larger aligned share is at least `subs_same_min`, Different when it is
/// at most `subs_diff_max`, Between otherwise (which raises `subtitle_ambiguous`). Spec 8.7 "Alignment".
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum Band {
    Same,
    Different,
    Between,
}

/// Spec 14's fixed share of 8.7 "Events": a track is full with at least 10% as many events as the largest English
/// track. Equal to `text::Rule::default().FULL_SHARE` (pinned by a test; Global Constraints' one-copy rule).
pub const FULL_SHARE: f64 = 0.10;

/// Spec 14's fixed limit of 8.7 "Forced" and "Other tracks": a separately authored forced track has fewer events; a
/// track that is not full with this many or more is dropped. Equal to `text::Rule::default().FORCED_MAX_EVENTS` (pinned
/// by a test).
pub const FORCED_MAX_EVENTS: usize = 150;

/// Which of spec 8.7's picks chose the dialogue group, in the spec's order. Spec 8.7 "Dialogue group".
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
pub enum DialoguePick {
    /// "With one full track, it is the dialogue track."
    OneFull,
    /// "the one containing the parent of a forced-only stream that has events".
    ForcedParent,
    /// "else the one TheDiscDB describes as subtitles or SDH".
    Described,
    /// "else the largest group if it has two or more tracks".
    Largest,
}
```

- [ ] **Step 8: Write "Set aside first" and the parent rule (spec 8.7 "Set aside first", its first sentence, Review Focus 4)**

In `crates/core/src/tracks/subtitle.rs`, insert this code on its own lines immediately before the line `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
/// What spec 8.7's "Set aside first" takes out of counting, alignment and grouping, and the streams left to count. Every
/// subtitle stream of the title is in exactly one list. Spec 8.7.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct SetAside {
    /// English or no-language derived forced-only streams (flags 4096 and 2048) with their parent (`parent_of`), in scan
    /// order.
    pub forced_only: Vec<(u32, Option<u32>)>,
    /// DVD streams flagged 1 or 2 (director's comments): dropped (DirectorsComments). A DVD title is one with
    /// attribute 24 (`Title.dvd_title` is Some); a Blu-ray stream flagged 1 or 2 is counted.
    pub directors_comments: Vec<u32>,
    /// The closed-caption stream (codec family ClosedCaptions), when the title has one.
    pub closed_captions: Option<u32>,
    /// Subtitle streams in another language, forced-only ones included (dropped, OtherLanguage), in scan order.
    pub other_language: Vec<u32>,
    /// The English and no-language streams left to count, in scan order (a DVD stream flagged forced, 4096 without
    /// 2048, included).
    pub counted: Vec<u32>,
}

/// Spec 8.7 "Set aside first" and its first sentence (other languages dropped), over the title's subtitle streams in
/// scan order. Each stream is tested in this order and lands in the first list that takes it: a language that is neither
/// English nor no-language goes to `other_language`; a derived forced-only stream (flags 4096 and 2048) to
/// `forced_only`, with its parent; on a DVD title (one with attribute 24, the DVD title number) a stream flagged 1 or 2
/// to `directors_comments`; the first closed-caption stream to `closed_captions`; every other stream to `counted`. A
/// Blu-ray stream flagged 1 or 2 is counted (the spec sets aside DVD streams only), and so is a second closed-caption
/// stream. Spec 8.7.
pub fn set_aside(title: &Title) -> SetAside {
    let subtitles = title.streams_of(StreamKind::Subtitles);
    let dvd = title.dvd_title.is_some();
    let mut out = SetAside {
        forced_only: Vec::new(),
        directors_comments: Vec::new(),
        closed_captions: None,
        other_language: Vec::new(),
        counted: Vec::new(),
    };
    for stream in &subtitles {
        if !english_or_none(stream.language.as_deref()) {
            out.other_language.push(stream.number);
        } else if stream.flags.derived_forced_only() {
            out.forced_only.push((stream.number, parent_of(&subtitles, stream.number)));
        } else if dvd && directors_comments(stream.flags) {
            out.directors_comments.push(stream.number);
        } else if stream.codec.family == Family::ClosedCaptions && out.closed_captions.is_none() {
            out.closed_captions = Some(stream.number);
        } else {
            out.counted.push(stream.number);
        }
    }
    out
}

/// The nearest preceding non-derived subtitle stream of the same language as stream `forced_only`, searching `streams`
/// backwards from it (streams of other kinds and streams flagged 2048 are skipped); None when there is none, when no
/// stream of `streams` is numbered `forced_only`, or when only other languages precede it: a forced-only stream is never
/// adopted by another language (Review Focus 4). Spec 8.7 "Set aside first".
pub fn parent_of(streams: &[&Stream], forced_only: u32) -> Option<u32> {
    let at = streams.iter().position(|stream| stream.number == forced_only)?;
    let language = streams[at].language.as_deref();
    streams[..at]
        .iter()
        .rev()
        .find(|stream| {
            stream.kind == StreamKind::Subtitles
                && !stream.flags.has(Flags::DERIVED)
                && same_language(stream.language.as_deref(), language)
        })
        .map(|stream| stream.number)
}

/// English ("eng" or "en") or no language (lang::is_no_language): the streams 8.7 counts. Spec 8.7, 8.6 "Languages".
pub(crate) fn english_or_none(language: Option<&str>) -> bool {
    is_no_language(language) || language.is_some_and(is_english)
}

/// Two attribute 3 codes name the same language: both no language; both English ("eng" or "en"); or equal through
/// lang::norm_lang (which joins the bibliographic and terminology codes of one language). A no-language code and a
/// language code are never the same language. Spec 8.7 "of the same language".
fn same_language(a: Option<&str>, b: Option<&str>) -> bool {
    if is_no_language(a) || is_no_language(b) {
        return is_no_language(a) && is_no_language(b);
    }
    if a.is_some_and(is_english) && b.is_some_and(is_english) {
        return true;
    }
    norm_lang(a) == norm_lang(b)
}

/// Flags 1 or 2: director's comments or alternate director's comments (spec 9.5; 8.7 "DVD streams flagged director's
/// comments").
fn directors_comments(flags: Flags) -> bool {
    flags.has(Flags::DIRECTORS_COMMENTS) || flags.has(Flags::ALT_DIRECTORS_COMMENTS)
}
```

```rust
    assert_eq!(events(&pgs, lower.sub_clear_max_bytes), Ok(vec![1.0, 3.5, 6.0, 8.0]));
```

```rust
/// Spec 8.7 "Events": a track is full when it has at least 10% (FULL_SHARE) as many events as the largest English track,
/// `largest` being that track's count, compared as the text rule compares it (`events as f64 >= FULL_SHARE * largest as
/// f64`, `subtitle::text`), which for a whole number of events is `events >= ceil(FULL_SHARE * largest)`. A track with 0
/// events is never full. Spec 8.7, 14 (the fixed 10%).
pub fn is_full(events: usize, largest: usize) -> bool {
    events > 0 && events as f64 >= FULL_SHARE * largest as f64
}
```

```rust
/// Spec 8.7 "Alignment": the larger of `aligned(a, b)` and `aligned(b, a)` (subtitle::align::aligned, the share of the
/// first list's starts within settings.subs_tolerance_s() of some start of the second), and its band: Same when it is at
/// least settings.subs_same_min, else Different when it is at most settings.subs_diff_max, else Between. Both lists are
/// sorted first (aligned needs its second list sorted; the caller's order never changes the answer). Two lists without
/// events share 0.0, Different. Reads settings.subs_tolerance_ms, subs_same_min and subs_diff_max. Spec 8.7, 14.
pub fn band(a: &[f64], b: &[f64], settings: &Settings) -> (f64, Band) {
    let tolerance = settings.subs_tolerance_s();
    let (a, b) = (sorted(a), sorted(b));
    let larger = aligned(&a, &b, tolerance).max(aligned(&b, &a, tolerance));
    let which = if larger >= settings.subs_same_min {
        Band::Same
    } else if larger <= settings.subs_diff_max {
        Band::Different
    } else {
        Band::Between
    };
    (larger, which)
}

/// A sorted copy of event start times (ascending, `f64::total_cmp`).
fn sorted(starts: &[f64]) -> Vec<f64> {
    let mut out = starts.to_vec();
    out.sort_by(f64::total_cmp);
    out
}
```

In `crates/core/src/tracks/subtitle.rs`, insert this code on its own lines immediately before the line `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
/// Spec 8.7 "Alignment" over the full tracks (stream number and event starts, in scan order): every pair is banded with
/// `band`; two tracks share a group when their band is Same, transitively (A with B and B with C puts A, B and C in one
/// group even when A and C are Different); `ambiguous` is true when any pair is Between (8.7: "In between: review
/// reason subtitle_ambiguous", which Task 10 raises). Groups come in order of their first stream, each listing its
/// streams in `full`'s order. Reads settings.subs_tolerance_ms, subs_same_min and subs_diff_max through `band`. Spec 8.7.
pub fn alignment_groups(full: &[(u32, &[f64])], settings: &Settings) -> (Vec<Vec<u32>>, bool) {
    // parent[i] is a track of i's group listed no later than i; the root of a group is its first track.
    let mut parent: Vec<usize> = (0..full.len()).collect();
    let mut ambiguous = false;
    for i in 0..full.len() {
        for j in (i + 1)..full.len() {
            match band(full[i].1, full[j].1, settings).1 {
                Band::Same => {
                    let (a, b) = (root(&parent, i), root(&parent, j));
                    if a != b {
                        parent[a.max(b)] = a.min(b);
                    }
                }
                Band::Between => ambiguous = true,
                Band::Different => {}
            }
        }
    }
    let mut groups: Vec<Vec<u32>> = Vec::new();
    let mut group_of_root: BTreeMap<usize, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (at, (number, _)) in full.iter().enumerate() {
        let first = root(&parent, at);
        let index = match group_of_root.get(&first) {
            Some(&index) => index,
            None => {
                groups.push(Vec::new());
                group_of_root.insert(first, groups.len() - 1);
                groups.len() - 1
            }
        };
        groups[index].push(*number);
    }
    (groups, ambiguous)
}

/// The first track of `at`'s group: follows `parent` until a track is its own parent.
fn root(parent: &[usize], mut at: usize) -> usize {
    while parent[at] != at {
        at = parent[at];
    }
    at
}
```

- [ ] **Step 24: Write the dialogue group (spec 8.7 "Dialogue group")**

In `crates/core/src/tracks/subtitle.rs`, insert this code on its own lines immediately before the line `#[cfg(test)]`:

```rust
/// Spec 8.7 "Dialogue group", over `groups` (alignment_groups' result), with the spec's picks in order: exactly one full
/// track overall (one group of one track) is OneFull; else the one group holding a stream of `forced_parents` (the
/// parents of forced-only streams that have events) is ForcedParent; else the one group holding a stream whose
/// `described` kinds (`tracks::audio::descriptions`) include Dialogue or Sdh is Described; else the largest group when
/// it has two or more tracks (two or more groups of that size tie and pick nothing: None, so the caller raises
/// subtitle_ambiguous; position never chooses the dialogue group, D15) is Largest; else None (the caller raises
/// subtitle_ambiguous). Forced parents in two or more groups contradict each other: None (subtitle_ambiguous);
/// descriptions in two or more groups name no group, and the largest group is tried. Returns the group's index and the
/// pick. Spec 8.7, D15.
pub fn dialogue_group(
    groups: &[Vec<u32>],
    forced_parents: &[u32],
    described: &BTreeMap<u32, Vec<DescriptionKind>>,
) -> Option<(usize, DialoguePick)> {
    if groups.len() == 1 && groups[0].len() == 1 {
        return Some((0, DialoguePick::OneFull));
    }
    let holding: Vec<usize> = groups
        .iter()
        .enumerate()
        .filter(|(_, group)| group.iter().any(|stream| forced_parents.contains(stream)))
        .map(|(index, _)| index)
        .collect();
    match holding.as_slice() {
        [index] => return Some((*index, DialoguePick::ForcedParent)),
        [] => {}
        _ => return None,
    }
    let says_dialogue = |stream: u32| {
        described.get(&stream).is_some_and(|kinds| {
            kinds.iter().any(|kind| matches!(kind, DescriptionKind::Dialogue | DescriptionKind::Sdh))
        })
    };
    if let Some(index) = only_group(groups, says_dialogue) {
        return Some((index, DialoguePick::Described));
    }
    let largest = groups.iter().map(Vec::len).max().unwrap_or(0);
    if largest >= 2 && groups.iter().filter(|group| group.len() == largest).count() == 1 {
        let index = groups.iter().position(|group| group.len() == largest)?;
        return Some((index, DialoguePick::Largest));
    }
    None
}

/// The index of the one group holding a stream for which `holds` is true; None when no group or two or more groups do.
/// Used by the Described pick only (split descriptions fall through to the largest group; split forced parents do not).
fn only_group(groups: &[Vec<u32>], holds: impl Fn(u32) -> bool) -> Option<usize> {
    let mut found = groups.iter().enumerate().filter(|(_, group)| group.iter().any(|&stream| holds(stream)));
    let (index, _) = found.next()?;
    if found.next().is_some() {
        None
    } else {
        Some(index)
    }
}
```

These compose the functions of Steps 8 to 24 as Task 10's `decide_subtitles` will (set aside, count, keep the full tracks, group, pick); they need no new code. Append to `crates/core/src/tracks/subtitle/tests.rs`:

```rust
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ the evidence end to end

/// The parents of the forced-only streams that have events (8.7 "Dialogue group": "the parent of a forced-only stream
/// that has events"), as Task 10's caller builds `forced_parents`.
fn forced_parents(aside: &SetAside, events: &BTreeMap<u32, Vec<f64>>) -> Vec<u32> {
    aside
        .forced_only
        .iter()
        .filter(|(stream, _)| events.get(stream).is_some_and(|starts| !starts.is_empty()))
        .filter_map(|&(_, parent)| parent)
        .collect()
}

/// The counted streams that are full against the largest counted stream (8.7 "Events"), with their starts, in scan
/// order; a counted stream absent from `events` has no events.
fn full_tracks<'e>(aside: &SetAside, events: &'e BTreeMap<u32, Vec<f64>>) -> Vec<(u32, &'e [f64])> {
    let count = |stream: &u32| events.get(stream).map_or(0, Vec::len);
    let largest = aside.counted.iter().map(count).max().unwrap_or(0);
    aside
        .counted
        .iter()
        .filter(|&stream| is_full(count(stream), largest))
        .map(|stream| (*stream, events.get(stream).map(Vec::as_slice).unwrap_or(&[])))
        .collect()
}

#[test]
fn d20s_regular_and_sdh_tracks_share_the_dialogue_group_and_a_commentary_track_stands_apart() {
    // A Blu-ray title: 2 a regular track, 3 its SDH track (the same starts plus two sound cues), 4 a commentary track,
    // 5 a derived forced-only stream (parent 4) that has no events, 6 Spanish.
    let title = title_of(
        false,
        &[
            ("video", "", 0),
            ("audio", "eng", 0),
            ("pgs", "eng", 0),
            ("pgs", "eng", 0),
            ("pgs", "eng", 0),
            ("pgs", "eng", 6144),
            ("pgs", "spa", 0),
        ],
    );
    let aside = set_aside(&title);
    assert_eq!(aside.forced_only, vec![(5, Some(4))]);
    assert_eq!(aside.other_language, vec![6]);
    assert_eq!(aside.counted, vec![2, 3, 4]);

    let mut sdh = ten();
    sdh.extend([5.0, 15.0]);
    let events: BTreeMap<u32, Vec<f64>> = BTreeMap::from([(2, ten()), (3, sdh), (4, sharing(2)), (5, vec![])]);
    let full = full_tracks(&aside, &events);
    assert_eq!(full.iter().map(|(stream, _)| *stream).collect::<Vec<u32>>(), vec![2, 3, 4]);
    let (groups, ambiguous) = alignment_groups(&full, &Settings::default());
    assert_eq!(groups, vec![vec![2, 3], vec![4]]);
    assert!(!ambiguous);
    let parents = forced_parents(&aside, &events);
    assert_eq!(parents, Vec::<u32>::new());
    assert_eq!(dialogue_group(&groups, &parents, &BTreeMap::new()), Some((0, DialoguePick::Largest)));
}

#[test]
fn smiles_forced_only_stream_with_events_picks_its_parents_group() {
    // Smile's title 12: English 3 and 21 are counted, each with a forced-only stream (4 and 22). With made-up starts,
    // 3 and 21 share 0.1 of their timing (Different groups); 4 has an event, so its parent 3 picks the group.
    let title = pinned_title(SMILE, 12);
    let aside = set_aside(&title);
    assert_eq!(aside.counted, vec![3, 21]);
    let events: BTreeMap<u32, Vec<f64>> =
        BTreeMap::from([(3, ten()), (4, vec![12.0]), (21, sharing(1)), (22, vec![])]);
    let full = full_tracks(&aside, &events);
    let (groups, ambiguous) = alignment_groups(&full, &Settings::default());
    assert_eq!(groups, vec![vec![3], vec![21]]);
    assert!(!ambiguous);
    assert_eq!(forced_parents(&aside, &events), vec![3]);
    assert_eq!(
        dialogue_group(&groups, &forced_parents(&aside, &events), &BTreeMap::new()),
        Some((0, DialoguePick::ForcedParent))
    );
    // Every forced-only stream empty (as on every disc recorded so far): no pick decides, and Task 10 raises
    // subtitle_ambiguous.
    let quiet: BTreeMap<u32, Vec<f64>> = BTreeMap::from([(3, ten()), (4, vec![]), (21, sharing(1)), (22, vec![])]);
    assert_eq!(forced_parents(&aside, &quiet), Vec::<u32>::new());
    assert_eq!(dialogue_group(&groups, &forced_parents(&aside, &quiet), &BTreeMap::new()), None);
}
```

```rust
/// only the keys it changes: absent keys take the default (`#[serde(default)]`); an unknown key is refused
/// (`deny_unknown_fields`). Def: T1. Use: every rule.

    /// Spec 7; None until set. Required by the engine, not by any rule here.

    pub tv_root: Option<String>,

    /// 1024: MakeMKV read cache, MB.
    pub cache_mb: u32,
    /// 0.85: confidence needed to file automatically (8.8, 6.2, 6.3).

    pub subs_diff_max: f64,
    /// 64: image-subtitle packets this small clear the screen (8.7).
    pub sub_clear_max_bytes: i64,
    /// Combined (8.9).
    pub edition_style: EditionStyle,
    /// false: add the square-bracket ID tag (8.9).
    pub jellyfin10_compat: bool,
    /// 7: days raw data of filed jobs is kept (7).
    pub retention_days: u32,
    /// true: D16.
    pub keep_tuning_evidence: bool,
    /// None; required while keep_tuning_evidence is on; not inside staging_root or a library root (7, 14).

/// else the largest group when it has two or more tracks (two or more groups of that size tie and pick nothing: None, so
/// the caller raises subtitle_ambiguous; position never chooses the dialogue group, D15) is Largest; else None (the caller
/// raises subtitle_ambiguous). Forced parents in two or more groups contradict each other: None (subtitle_ambiguous);
/// descriptions in two or more groups name no group, and the largest group is tried. Returns the group's index and the
```

```rust
/// Def: T10. Use: T11, T13, T16, T18.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
pub struct SubtitleDecision {
    /// In order forced, regular, SDH (8.10).
    pub kept: Vec<SubtitleTrack>,
    pub dropped: Vec<(u32, SubtitleDrop)>,
    /// Set aside (8.7): derived forced-only streams with their parents, flagged DVD streams, the closed-caption stream,
    /// the streams TheDiscDB describes as commentary (R6); each with a sentence.
    pub set_aside: Vec<(u32, String)>,
    pub full: Vec<u32>,
    pub groups: Vec<Vec<u32>>,
    /// When groups exist and no rule picks one (two largest groups of equal size included): Some(0), the first group
    /// standing in for the regular and SDH roles, with dialogue_pick None and subtitle_ambiguous raised.
    pub dialogue_group: Option<usize>,
    pub dialogue_pick: Option<DialoguePick>,

/// Spec 8.7 in full, in order: `set_aside`; a counted stream in the file that TheDiscDB describes as commentary (not as
/// dialogue or SDH) is set aside and dropped (OutsideDialogueGroup; R6, D15); events from `facts.events`; full =
/// `is_full` against the largest English track's events (a stream flagged forced, 4096 without 2048, is never full: its
/// flag makes it a forced source); `alignment_groups` over the full tracks with the three bands (a Between pair raises
/// subtitle_ambiguous); `dialogue_group` with the parents of forced-only streams that have events and
/// `tracks::audio::descriptions` (None, two largest groups of equal size included, raises subtitle_ambiguous, and the
/// first group stands in for the regular and SDH roles); regular and SDH (up to two: more events is SDH, a description
/// saying SDH overrides; the closed-caption stream is SDH when the group has none; more than two gives
/// subtitle_ambiguous, and a track described SDH is one of the two kept); full tracks outside a picked group dropped
/// (OutsideDialogueGroup; with no pick, or with a Between band against a track of the picked group, they are kept as
/// regular under the review, never dropped unconfirmed or by position); forced (first: a forced-only stream with events
/// whose parent is the regular track, then the SDH track's; then a DVD stream flagged forced; then a separately
/// authored track that is not full with fewer than FORCED_MAX_EVENTS events); other not-full tracks with
/// FORCED_MAX_EVENTS or more events dropped with partial_subtitle_dropped, those with no events dropped NoEvents;
/// `text_disagreements` (subtitle_ambiguous and one subtitle_text_disagrees note per stream); the confidence case;
/// remembered then review overrides applied last (decided_by "remembered" or "reviewed"; an override naming a stream
/// that is not an English or no-language subtitle stream is ignored), with confidence lookup::REMEMBERED_CONFIDENCE
/// (1.00) and subtitle_ambiguous cleared when every English and no-language subtitle stream of the title still in the
/// file (not in facts.removed) has an override (other-language streams are dropped by 8.7's first sentence; the case
/// unchanged). A title with one English stream and no events keeps it as Regular "English" (row 14 (b) fallback), case
/// OneFull; when that stream is flagged forced (4096 without 2048) it is kept as Forced by its flag, case
/// FlagsOrDescriptions. Def: T10. Use: T13, T16, T18.
pub fn decide_subtitles(title: &Title, facts: &SubtitleFacts<'_>, settings: &Settings) -> SubtitleDecision;
/// 8.7 "Text": the streams where a text decision differs from the counts, for any English or no-language stream: its
/// role (Regular, Sdh, Forced, Drop) differs from the kept role (or kept against a Drop, or dropped against a kept
/// role). SetAside never disagrees; Keep, and any verdict carrying the text rule's review, always disagree
/// (text::before_yes's reading: text::decide writes Keep only with its own review).
/// The public form of the rule's text check, which decide_subtitles reaches through the private `disagreements`; kept
/// for phase 2's review view. Def: T10. Use: T10.
pub fn text_disagreements(decision: &SubtitleDecision, text: &BTreeMap<u32, crate::subtitle::text::Decision>) -> Vec<u32>;
```

`SubtitleCase::ALL` (the five cases in the table's order), `SubtitleCase::as_str` and `impl std::str::FromStr for SubtitleCase` (only the snake_case spellings) follow the Global Constraints' convention for closed sets and are in the entry above. `SubtitleDrop::NoEvents` (`no_events`) is Task 9's variant, added to its enum for this task's drops of counted streams with no events.

Where this task settles what the spec and the interfaces leave open (each choice is pinned by a test below):

1. **Where the code goes.** The rule is a private module `roles` inside `tracks/subtitle.rs`, with its own `use` lines, and its public items are re-exported by one `pub use roles::{...}` line, so they are `tracks::subtitle::decide_subtitles` and so on as the interfaces name them. Task 9's half of the file already imports `SubtitleOverride`, `Decision`, `Settings` and others for its own items; a second import of the same name at the file's top level would not compile, and a module of its own keeps both halves readable. The tests are a module `roles` at the end of Task 9's `tests.rs`, run with the filter `tracks::subtitle::tests::roles::`. The `//!` header of the file is Task 9's and already names this task's sections; the module's own `//!` paragraph names them again.
2. **Which stream is which.** `set_aside`'s five lists (Task 9) decide it, and every subtitle stream is in exactly one: `other_language` streams are dropped `OtherLanguage`, `directors_comments` streams `DirectorsComments` (each also listed in `set_aside` with its sentence), `forced_only` and `closed_captions` are set aside with their sentences, `counted` streams are counted. The title "has no English subtitle stream" (the table's first row) when no subtitle stream is English or no-language (Task 9's `english_or_none`, the one copy). A counted stream in the file that TheDiscDB describes as commentary (`DescriptionKind::Commentary` from `tracks::audio::descriptions`, and neither Dialogue nor Sdh) is confirmed commentary (R6 never keeps commentary subtitles; D15 lets a database entry confirm it): it is listed in `set_aside` with the sentence of choice 12, takes no part in alignment or grouping (it is never full), and is dropped `OutsideDialogueGroup`, whatever its count. Task 9's `SubtitleDrop` has no variant for a described drop and the interfaces keep its variants, so the set-aside sentence says why.
3. **Events.** A stream's events are `facts.events`; a stream absent from it, or one in `facts.removed` (MakeMKV removed it as empty, `MSG:4047`), has none. "The largest English track" is the largest counted stream (English and no-language), as Task 9's end-to-end tests count it. A removed counted stream is not in the file: it is never kept and never the one-stream fallback, and it is dropped `NoEvents` (choice 7).
4. **No pick.** When groups exist and `dialogue_group` picks none, the decision raises `subtitle_ambiguous` and the first group (in order of its first stream) stands in for the regular and SDH roles, so a job the owner approves without changes still files English subtitles: `dialogue_group` is `Some(0)` and `dialogue_pick` is `None`. With no pick nothing is confirmed as commentary, so the full tracks of the other groups are not dropped: spec 8.7 drops a full track only when it is outside a picked dialogue group, D20 keeps and reviews an unconfirmed track, and D15 forbids deciding by a track's position on the disc. They are kept as regular "English" (`decided_by` "alignment") under the review already raised, and the owner's Override tracks settle them. Two groups tied for the largest size are no pick: Task 9's `dialogue_group` returns None on the tie, so this rule applies to them and no full track is dropped for its place on the disc. With a pick, a full track outside the dialogue group whose band with a track of the group is Between is kept the same way, as regular under `subtitle_ambiguous`: 8.7 calls that pair undecided, so nothing confirms the track as commentary, and D20 keeps and reviews an unconfirmed track. Only a full track outside a picked group whose bands with the group's tracks are all Different is dropped `OutsideDialogueGroup`. Two or more counted streams in the file with no full track (no events at all) leave no group: `subtitle_ambiguous`, nothing kept, both dropped `NoEvents`.
5. **Regular and SDH.** Of two dialogue tracks, a TheDiscDB description saying SDH (`DescriptionKind::Sdh` from `tracks::audio::descriptions`) on exactly one makes it SDH and the other regular, both `decided_by` "description"; on both or neither, the count decides. Equal counts cannot decide: `subtitle_ambiguous`, the first in scan order regular, the second SDH. A one-track group whose description says SDH is SDH (`decided_by` "description"). More than two tracks: `subtitle_ambiguous`, and two are kept: the tracks a TheDiscDB description calls SDH first (a description saying SDH overrides the count, so such a track is never dropped as an extra one), then those with the most events (ties by scan order); the others are `ExtraDialogueTrack`. A dialogue track is `decided_by` "count" when it is the one full track and "alignment" when there are two or more full tracks.
6. **Closed captions.** The closed-caption stream is kept as SDH (`hearing_impaired`, `closed_captions`, "English (SDH)", `decided_by` "closed_captions") whenever no SDH dialogue track is kept, also when no dialogue group exists (a DVD whose only English subtitle is its captions); otherwise it is dropped `ClosedCaptionsUnused`.
7. **Forced.** Every source needs at least one event, except a stream flagged forced that is the only English or no-language stream in the file left to judge (not described as commentary): 6.4 step 10 does not run for one English stream, so it has no events, and its flag alone makes it the forced track (8.7 "Forced"; section 17 row 14 (a) counts a forced track labelled regular without review as costly). "A DVD stream flagged forced" is a counted stream with 4096 and without 2048 (`Flags::forced_authored`); `set_aside` counts it, on a DVD or not. Such a stream is never full, whatever its count: its flag makes it a forced source (8.7 "Forced"; the confidence table's first row lets flags decide), so it never joins a dialogue group and never turns the dialogue track into SDH. The case is real: Firefly disc 1's pinned log flags its French and Spanish DVD forced-only streams 7 and 8 with 4096 (tree info "(forced only)"), and a forced track timed on the dialogue with 10% of its events would otherwise be full, aligned with it, and taken as the larger group's second track. A not-full counted track that is not the forced track is dropped `Partial` with the note when it has 150 events or more, `NoEvents` when it has none (MakeMKV removed it, or 6.4 step 10 measured nothing for it; Task 9's `SubtitleDrop::NoEvents`, so the decision document never calls an ordinary dialogue track an extra forced one), else `ExtraForced`. A forced-only stream not kept is `DerivedForcedOnlyUnused` when it has events, else `DerivedForcedOnlyEmpty`. The forced track's `parent` is the forced-only stream's parent; a stream flagged forced and a separately authored track have none.
8. **The one-stream fallback (row 14 (b)).** One counted stream in the file (not described as commentary) and no events: kept as regular "English", `decided_by` "single", case `OneFull` (0.90, Open point 12). A stream flagged forced (4096 without 2048) is not this fallback: it is kept as forced by its flag (choice 7), `decided_by` "flag", case `FlagsOrDescriptions` (0.95).
9. **The confidence case,** in this order: `Ambiguous` when `subtitle_ambiguous` was raised; with no counted stream in the file, `NoEnglish` when the title has no English or no-language subtitle stream, else `FlagsOrDescriptions` (flags or the closed-caption type decided every track); `FlagsOrDescriptions` when every counted stream in the file is kept with `decided_by` "flag" or "description", or dropped as described commentary (choice 2); `Alignment` with two or more full tracks; else `OneFull`.
10. **Text (Open point 13).** The text is compared before the overrides, on every stream of `facts.text` that the decision keeps or drops for any reason but another language, and never on a stream with an override (the owner decided it). Each disagreeing stream adds `subtitle_ambiguous` and one `subtitle_text_disagrees` note, in stream order, whose detail is `stream <n>: the text reads <role>, the counts keep it as <role> (8.7 "Text")` or `stream <n>: the text reads <role>, the counts drop it (8.7 "Text")`. The text never changes a role, a drop or a flag. SetAside never disagrees. A text verdict of Keep always disagrees, and so does any verdict that carries the text rule's review, whatever its role: `text::decide` writes Keep only together with its own review (for example "text and timing disagree with the dialogue group" or "a second forced candidate"), and `text::before_yes` counts both another role and a review that 8.7 does not raise as a disagreement. So a stream the counts drop while the text keeps it for review is still dropped, but under `subtitle_ambiguous` with its note.
11. **Overrides (spec 5, 11, 8.8).** Remembered entries are matched by signature (`remembered::apply_subtitles`); the owner's `reviewed` entries replace a remembered one on the same stream; an entry naming a stream that is not one of the title's English or no-language subtitle streams is ignored (another language's stream is dropped by 8.7's first sentence, and `SubtitleRole` names only English roles, so a kept Spanish stream would be labelled "English"). An override removes the rule's outcome and the notes naming its stream; `Keep { role }` keeps the stream with that role (a forced-only stream keeps its parent; the closed-caption stream keeps `closed_captions`). The confidence is 1.00 (`lookup::REMEMBERED_CONFIDENCE`) when every English and no-language subtitle stream still in the file (not in `facts.removed`) has an override: streams in other languages are dropped by the rule's first sentence, and the owner's Override tracks choose among the file's tracks, so they need not name a stream MakeMKV removed as empty. Full coverage also clears `subtitle_ambiguous`, because the review decision answers it (8.8: a job with a review reason never files, so an approved override that left the reason in place would hold the job again). The case stays the rule's. The interfaces entry of `decide_subtitles` states this rule.
12. **Sentences.** Set aside: `derived forced-only stream of stream <p> (flags 4096 and 2048; 8.7 "Set aside first")`, or `derived forced-only stream with no preceding stream of its language (flags 4096 and 2048; 8.7 "Set aside first")`; `DVD stream flagged director's comments (flags 1 or 2; 8.7 "Set aside first")`; `DVD closed-caption stream (codec CC; 8.7 "Set aside first")`; `described as commentary by TheDiscDB (R6)`. The partial note: `stream <n>: <events> events, not full (the largest English track has <largest>) and 150 or more (8.7 "Other tracks")`.
13. **Settings.** `decide_subtitles` reads `subs_tolerance_ms`, `subs_same_min` and `subs_diff_max`, through Task 9's `band` and `alignment_groups`; three tests run each at its default and at one other value (3000 ms, 0.50, 0.50). `sub_clear_max_bytes` is applied where the events are counted (Task 12's `verify::subtitle_events`), not here.

```rust
pub use roles::{
    confidence, SubtitleCase, SUBTITLE_ALIGNMENT_CONFIDENCE, SUBTITLE_AMBIGUOUS_CONFIDENCE, SUBTITLE_FLAGS_CONFIDENCE,
    SUBTITLE_ONE_FULL_CONFIDENCE,
};

mod roles {
    //! Spec 8.7 from "Regular and SDH" to the confidence table, and 8.7 "Text" (D20, D23, section 17 row 14's
    //! fallback): the roles of the kept English subtitle tracks, the forced track, the drops of every other subtitle
    //! stream, the confidence of the subtitle decision and the reviews the text rule adds; then the remembered and
    //! review overrides of spec 5 and 11. Built on the evidence half of this file (8.7 "Set aside first" to "Dialogue
    //! group": `set_aside`, `is_full`, `band`, `alignment_groups`, `dialogue_group`). A private module with its own
    //! `use` lines, so that its names never meet those of the evidence half; the `pub use` line above it re-exports its
    //! public items as `tracks::subtitle::*`. Written from the spec (RP20). Used by Tasks 11, 13, 16 and 18.

    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the confidence table

    /// Spec 8.7's confidence table, first row: flags or database descriptions decide every track, or the title has no
    /// English subtitle stream. Def: T10. Use: T10, T13.
    pub const SUBTITLE_FLAGS_CONFIDENCE: f64 = 0.95;
    /// Second row: exactly one full English track. Def: T10. Use: T10, T13.
    pub const SUBTITLE_ONE_FULL_CONFIDENCE: f64 = 0.90;
    /// Third row: alignment decides between two or more full tracks, with every pair outside the in-between band.
    /// Def: T10. Use: T10, T13.
    pub const SUBTITLE_ALIGNMENT_CONFIDENCE: f64 = 0.85;
    /// Fourth row: subtitle_ambiguous was raised. Def: T10. Use: T10, T13.
    pub const SUBTITLE_AMBIGUOUS_CONFIDENCE: f64 = 0.60;

    /// The confidence rows of 8.7's table. The first row has two cases: flags or descriptions decided (no English or
    /// no-language stream was left to counting and timing, or every counted one was kept by its flag or by its
    /// TheDiscDB description), and no English subtitle stream at all. Spec 8.7. Def: T10. Use: T10, T13.
    #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
    #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
    pub enum SubtitleCase {
        /// Row 1: flags or database descriptions decide every track.
        FlagsOrDescriptions,
        /// Row 1: the title has no English or no-language subtitle stream.
        NoEnglish,
        /// Row 2: exactly one full English track, and the one-stream fallback of section 17 row 14 (b).
        OneFull,
        /// Row 3: alignment decided between two or more full tracks.
        Alignment,
        /// Row 4: subtitle_ambiguous was raised.
        Ambiguous,
    }

    impl SubtitleCase {
        /// Every case, in the table's order. Spec 8.7.
        pub const ALL: [SubtitleCase; 5] = [
            SubtitleCase::FlagsOrDescriptions,
            SubtitleCase::NoEnglish,
            SubtitleCase::OneFull,
            SubtitleCase::Alignment,
            SubtitleCase::Ambiguous,
        ];

        /// The snake_case spelling, as serde writes it. Spec 8.7.
        pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
            match self {
                SubtitleCase::FlagsOrDescriptions => "flags_or_descriptions",
                SubtitleCase::NoEnglish => "no_english",
                SubtitleCase::OneFull => "one_full",
                SubtitleCase::Alignment => "alignment",
                SubtitleCase::Ambiguous => "ambiguous",
            }
        }
    }

    impl std::str::FromStr for SubtitleCase {
        type Err = String;

        /// Only the `as_str` spellings.
        fn from_str(text: &str) -> Result<SubtitleCase, String> {
            SubtitleCase::ALL
                .into_iter()
                .find(|case| case.as_str() == text)
                .ok_or_else(|| format!("not a subtitle confidence case: {text}"))
        }
    }

    /// The table's value for a case (FlagsOrDescriptions and NoEnglish 0.95, OneFull 0.90, Alignment 0.85, Ambiguous
    /// 0.60). Spec 8.7. Def: T10. Use: T10.
    pub fn confidence(case: SubtitleCase) -> f64 {
        match case {
            SubtitleCase::FlagsOrDescriptions | SubtitleCase::NoEnglish => SUBTITLE_FLAGS_CONFIDENCE,
            SubtitleCase::OneFull => SUBTITLE_ONE_FULL_CONFIDENCE,
            SubtitleCase::Alignment => SUBTITLE_ALIGNMENT_CONFIDENCE,
            SubtitleCase::Ambiguous => SUBTITLE_AMBIGUOUS_CONFIDENCE,
        }
    }
}
```

```rust
    /// A kept track as `decide_subtitles` builds it: the role's name and flags, not default, not closed captions, no parent.
    fn track(stream: u32, role: SubtitleRole, events: Option<usize>, decided_by: &str) -> SubtitleTrack {
        SubtitleTrack {
            stream,
            role,
            name: role.name().to_string(),
            forced: role == SubtitleRole::Forced,
            hearing_impaired: role == SubtitleRole::Sdh,
            default: false,
            events,
            closed_captions: false,
            parent: None,
            decided_by: decided_by.to_string(),
        }
    }

    /// The text rule's decision for one stream, with no review and no note.
    fn verdict(role: Role) -> Decision {
        Decision { role, review: None, note: None }
    }

    /// A decision keeping stream 1 as regular and stream 2 as SDH, dropping stream 3 (a full track outside the dialogue
    /// group) and stream 4 (Spanish).
    fn two_kept() -> SubtitleDecision {
        SubtitleDecision {
            kept: vec![
                track(1, SubtitleRole::Regular, Some(1000), "alignment"),
                track(2, SubtitleRole::Sdh, Some(1200), "alignment"),
            ],
            dropped: vec![(3, SubtitleDrop::OutsideDialogueGroup), (4, SubtitleDrop::OtherLanguage)],
            set_aside: vec![],
            full: vec![1, 2, 3],
            groups: vec![vec![1, 2], vec![3]],
            dialogue_group: Some(0),
            dialogue_pick: Some(DialoguePick::Largest),
            pairs: vec![(1, 2, 1.0, Band::Same), (1, 3, 0.0, Band::Different), (2, 3, 0.0, Band::Different)],
            case: SubtitleCase::Alignment,
            confidence: SUBTITLE_ALIGNMENT_CONFIDENCE,
            notes: vec![],
            reviews: vec![],
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn set_aside_verdicts_never_disagree_and_keep_always_does() {
        // text::decide writes Keep only with its own review: the text asks for a review that the counts did not raise,
        // on a kept track (1) and on a dropped one (3) alike. SetAside (2) never disagrees.
        let decision = two_kept();
        let text = BTreeMap::from([(1, verdict(Role::Keep)), (2, verdict(Role::SetAside)), (3, verdict(Role::Keep))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &text), vec![1, 3]);
        // A verdict carrying the text rule's review disagrees even when its role is the kept one (text::before_yes).
        let reviewed = BTreeMap::from([(
            1,
            Decision { role: Role::Regular, review: Some("subtitle_ambiguous".to_string()), note: None },
        )]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &reviewed), vec![1]);
        let set_aside = BTreeMap::from([(
            2,
            Decision { role: Role::SetAside, review: Some("subtitle_ambiguous".to_string()), note: None },
        )]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &set_aside), Vec::<u32>::new());
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_text_role_other_than_the_kept_role_disagrees() {
        let decision = two_kept();
        let same = BTreeMap::from([(1, verdict(Role::Regular)), (2, verdict(Role::Sdh))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &same), Vec::<u32>::new());
        let swapped = BTreeMap::from([(1, verdict(Role::Sdh)), (2, verdict(Role::Regular))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &swapped), vec![1, 2]);
        let forced = BTreeMap::from([(1, verdict(Role::Forced)), (2, verdict(Role::Sdh))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &forced), vec![1]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_text_drop_disagrees_with_a_kept_track_and_a_text_role_with_a_dropped_one() {
        let decision = two_kept();
        let drop_kept = BTreeMap::from([(1, verdict(Role::Drop))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &drop_kept), vec![1]);
        let drop_dropped = BTreeMap::from([(3, verdict(Role::Drop))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &drop_dropped), Vec::<u32>::new());
        let keep_dropped = BTreeMap::from([(3, verdict(Role::Regular))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &keep_dropped), vec![3]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn streams_in_other_languages_or_outside_the_decision_are_never_compared() {
        let decision = two_kept();
        let text = BTreeMap::from([(4, verdict(Role::Regular)), (9, verdict(Role::Sdh))]);
        assert_eq!(text_disagreements(&decision, &text), Vec::<u32>::new());
    }
```

```rust
    // ------------------------------------------------------------------ the decision and the text's disagreements

    /// A kept subtitle track. Spec 8.7 ("Regular and SDH", "Forced") and 8.10 (its name and flags). Def: T10. Use: T11,
    /// T13, T16.
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
    pub struct SubtitleTrack {
        /// The scan's stream number.
        pub stream: u32,
        /// Forced, regular or SDH (8.10's order).
        pub role: SubtitleRole,
        /// `role.name()`: "English (Forced)", "English" or "English (SDH)" (8.7).
        pub name: String,
        /// True for the forced role (8.7 "Flag it forced").
        pub forced: bool,
        /// True for the SDH role (8.7 "hearing-impaired flag"; the closed-caption stream is SDH by type).
        pub hearing_impaired: bool,
        /// Always false in the SubtitleDecision; the file's default subtitle is the Layout's OutputTrack.default (8.10,
        /// `tracks::layout::default_subtitle`).
        pub default: bool,
        /// The stream's event count from 6.4 step 10; None when the step measured nothing for it.
        pub events: Option<usize>,
        /// True for the DVD closed-caption stream.
        pub closed_captions: bool,
        /// For a forced-only stream, its parent.
        pub parent: Option<u32>,
        /// How this track was decided: "flag", "description", "count", "alignment", "closed_captions", "single",
        /// "remembered", "reviewed".
        pub decided_by: String,
    }

    /// One title's subtitle decision. Spec 8.7. Def: T10. Use: T11, T13, T16, T18.
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, serde::Serialize, serde::Deserialize)]
    pub struct SubtitleDecision {
        /// In order forced, regular, SDH (8.10); within one role by stream number.
        pub kept: Vec<SubtitleTrack>,
        /// Every subtitle stream that is not kept, with why, by stream number (8.7's first sentence).
        pub dropped: Vec<(u32, SubtitleDrop)>,
        /// Set aside (8.7): derived forced-only streams with their parents, flagged DVD streams, the closed-caption
        /// stream, the streams TheDiscDB describes as commentary (R6); each with a sentence; by stream number.
        pub set_aside: Vec<(u32, String)>,
        /// The full English and no-language tracks (8.7 "Events"), in scan order.
        pub full: Vec<u32>,
        /// `alignment_groups` over the full tracks.
        pub groups: Vec<Vec<u32>>,
        /// The index in `groups` of the dialogue group. When groups exist and no rule of 8.7 picks one (two largest
        /// groups of equal size included), the first group stands in for the regular and SDH roles, `dialogue_pick` is
        /// None and subtitle_ambiguous is raised; the full tracks of the other groups are then kept as regular, not
        /// dropped (D15, D20).
        pub dialogue_group: Option<usize>,
        /// Which rule picked the dialogue group.
        pub dialogue_pick: Option<DialoguePick>,
        /// Every pair of full tracks in scan order, with the larger aligned share and its band (8.7 "Alignment").
        pub pairs: Vec<(u32, u32, f64, Band)>,
        /// The row of 8.7's confidence table.
        pub case: SubtitleCase,
        /// `confidence(case)`, or 1.00 when remembered or review overrides cover every English and no-language
        /// subtitle stream of the title still in the file (spec 5, 8.8).
        pub confidence: f64,
        /// partial_subtitle_dropped and subtitle_text_disagrees, each naming its stream, in the order raised.
        pub notes: Vec<Noted>,
        /// subtitle_ambiguous, or nothing (sorted and unique).
        pub reviews: Vec<ReviewReason>,
    }

    /// The streams where the text rule's verdict differs from the decision's, with the text's role and the kept role
    /// (None when the decision drops the stream), in stream order. A stream of `text` is compared when the decision
    /// keeps it or drops it for any reason but another language (an English or no-language stream). SetAside never
    /// differs; Keep always differs (`text::decide` writes Keep only with its own review: the text asks for a review
    /// 8.7 did not raise); Drop differs from any kept role; Regular, Sdh and Forced differ from a drop and from another
    /// kept role; and any verdict but SetAside that carries the text rule's review differs (`text::before_yes` reads a
    /// review that 8.7 does not raise as a disagreement). Spec 8.7 "Text", Open point 13, D20.
    fn disagreements(
        kept: &[SubtitleTrack],
        dropped: &BTreeMap<u32, SubtitleDrop>,
        text: &BTreeMap<u32, Decision>,
    ) -> Vec<(u32, Role, Option<SubtitleRole>)> {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        for (&stream, verdict) in text {
            let role = kept.iter().find(|track| track.stream == stream).map(|track| track.role);
            let why = dropped.get(&stream);
            if role.is_none() && why.is_none() {
                continue;
            }
            if matches!(why, Some(SubtitleDrop::OtherLanguage)) {
                continue;
            }
            // A review as text::before_yes reads one: present and not empty.
            let reviewed = verdict.review.as_deref().is_some_and(|review| !review.is_empty());
            let differs = match verdict.role {
                Role::SetAside => false,
                // text::decide writes Keep only with its own review: the text asks for a review 8.7 did not raise.
                Role::Keep => true,
                Role::Drop => role.is_some(),
                Role::Regular => role != Some(SubtitleRole::Regular),
                Role::Sdh => role != Some(SubtitleRole::Sdh),
                Role::Forced => role != Some(SubtitleRole::Forced),
            } || (verdict.role != Role::SetAside && reviewed);
            if differs {
                out.push((stream, verdict.role, role));
            }
        }
        out
    }

    /// 8.7 "Text": the streams where a text decision differs from the counts, for any English or no-language stream:
    /// its role (Regular, Sdh, Forced, Drop) differs from the kept role (or kept against a Drop, or dropped against a
    /// kept role). SetAside never disagrees; Keep, and any verdict carrying the text rule's review, always disagree
    /// (text::before_yes's reading: text::decide writes Keep only with its own review). Streams dropped as another
    /// language's, and streams the decision does not list, are not compared. In stream order. The public form of the
    /// rule's text check, kept for phase 2's review view. Def: T10. Use: T10.
    pub fn text_disagreements(decision: &SubtitleDecision, text: &BTreeMap<u32, Decision>) -> Vec<u32> {
        let dropped: BTreeMap<u32, SubtitleDrop> = decision.dropped.iter().cloned().collect();
        disagreements(&decision.kept, &dropped, text).into_iter().map(|(stream, _, _)| stream).collect()
    }
```

```rust
    // Streams as Task 9's `title_of` takes them: (kind, language, flags attribute 22).
    const VIDEO: (&str, &str, u32) = ("video", "", 0);
    const ENG_PGS: (&str, &str, u32) = ("pgs", "eng", 0);
    const ENG_PGS_FORCED_ONLY: (&str, &str, u32) = ("pgs", "eng", 6144);
    const SPA_PGS: (&str, &str, u32) = ("pgs", "spa", 0);
    const ENG_VOBSUB: (&str, &str, u32) = ("vobsub", "eng", 0);
    const ENG_VOBSUB_FORCED: (&str, &str, u32) = ("vobsub", "eng", 4096);
    const ENG_VOBSUB_FORCED_ONLY: (&str, &str, u32) = ("vobsub", "eng", 6144);
    const SPA_VOBSUB: (&str, &str, u32) = ("vobsub", "spa", 0);
    const ENG_CC: (&str, &str, u32) = ("cc", "eng", 0);

    /// Title 0 of a made-up Blu-ray scan holding `streams`, numbered from 0 (Task 9's `title_of`).
    fn bluray(streams: &[(&str, &str, u32)]) -> Title {
        title_of(false, streams)
    }

    /// Title 0 of a made-up DVD scan (attribute 24 "01", no attribute 16) holding `streams`.
    fn dvd(streams: &[(&str, &str, u32)]) -> Title {
        title_of(true, streams)
    }

    /// `count` start times, the first at `first` seconds, one every `step` seconds.
    fn times(count: usize, first: f64, step: f64) -> Vec<f64> {
        (0..count).map(|k| first + step * k as f64).collect()
    }

    /// Two series as one, sorted.
    fn merged(mut a: Vec<f64>, b: Vec<f64>) -> Vec<f64> {
        a.extend(b);
        a.sort_by(|x, y| x.partial_cmp(y).unwrap());
        a
    }

    /// 1,000 dialogue events, one every 6 s from 10 s.
    fn regular_events() -> Vec<f64> {
        times(1000, 10.0, 6.0)
    }

    /// The dialogue's 1,000 events and 200 sound cues 3 s after the first 200 of them: 1,200 events. Against
    /// `regular_events` the larger aligned share is 1.0 (every dialogue event starts at an SDH event).
    fn sdh_events() -> Vec<f64> {
        merged(regular_events(), times(200, 13.0, 6.0))
    }

    /// 800 events, each 2.5 s after a dialogue event: no start within 300 ms of `regular_events`' or `sdh_events`'
    /// (aligned share 0.0), every start within 3 s of one (aligned share 1.0 under a 3,000 ms tolerance).
    fn commentary_events() -> Vec<f64> {
        times(800, 12.5, 6.0)
    }

    /// 20 events of a forced track, one a minute from 100 s.
    fn forced_events() -> Vec<f64> {
        times(20, 100.0, 60.0)
    }

    /// Two full tracks whose larger aligned share is exactly 0.5: the dialogue's 1,000 events, and 1,100 events whose
    /// first 500 are the dialogue's first 500 and whose other 600 start 2.5 s off it. aligned(A, B) = 500/1000 = 0.5,
    /// aligned(B, A) = 500/1100; 0.5 lies between subs_diff_max 0.30 and subs_same_min 0.70.
    fn between_events() -> (Vec<f64>, Vec<f64>) {
        (regular_events(), merged(times(500, 10.0, 6.0), times(600, 3012.5, 6.0)))
    }

    /// Facts with these event series and nothing else.
    fn facts<'a>(events: Vec<(u32, Vec<f64>)>) -> SubtitleFacts<'a> {
        SubtitleFacts { events: events.into_iter().collect(), ..SubtitleFacts::default() }
    }

    /// The set-aside sentence of a derived forced-only stream whose parent is `parent`.
    fn forced_only_of(parent: u32) -> String {
        format!("derived forced-only stream of stream {parent} (flags 4096 and 2048; 8.7 \"Set aside first\")")
    }

    /// (stream, role, decided_by) of every kept track, in the decision's order.
    fn kept_roles(decision: &SubtitleDecision) -> Vec<(u32, SubtitleRole, String)> {
        decision.kept.iter().map(|kept| (kept.stream, kept.role, kept.decided_by.clone())).collect()
    }

    #[test]
    fn smile_title_14_keeps_the_forced_only_stream_of_the_regular_track_then_regular_and_sdh() {
        // Smile's main feature (title 14, 00040.mpls) lists English PGS streams 11, 13 and 31, each followed by its
        // derived forced-only stream (12, 14, 32: flags 6144), and 30 streams in seven other languages (15 to 30 and 33
        // to 46: German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Turkish). The events are made up: 11 is the
        // dialogue, 13 the same dialogue with sound cues, 31 a commentary off the dialogue's timing; 12 has 20 events,
        // MakeMKV removed 14, and 32 has none.
        let title = pinned_title(SMILE, 14);
        let evidence = SubtitleFacts {
            removed: BTreeSet::from([14]),
            ..facts(vec![(11, regular_events()), (12, forced_events()), (13, sdh_events()), (31, commentary_events())])
        };
        let decision = decide_subtitles(&title, &evidence, &Settings::default());
        let dropped: Vec<(u32, SubtitleDrop)> = (14..=46)
            .map(|stream| {

            })
            .collect();

            kept_roles(&decision),
            vec![(1, SubtitleRole::Regular, "alignment".to_string()), (2, SubtitleRole::Sdh, "alignment".to_string())]
        );
        assert_eq!(decision.dropped, vec![(3, SubtitleDrop::OutsideDialogueGroup)]);
        assert_eq!(decision.groups, vec![vec![1, 2], vec![3]]);
        assert_eq!(decision.dialogue_pick, Some(DialoguePick::Largest));
        assert_eq!(
            decision.pairs,
            vec![(1, 2, 1.0, Band::Same), (1, 3, 0.0, Band::Different), (2, 3, 0.0, Band::Different)]
        );
        assert_eq!((decision.case, decision.confidence, decision.reviews.clone()), (SubtitleCase::Alignment, 0.85, vec![]));
    }

    #[test]
    fn a_title_without_english_subtitles_is_the_no_english_case_at_095() {

        let none = decide_subtitles(&bluray(&[VIDEO]), &SubtitleFacts::default(), &Settings::default());

    #[test]
    fn the_forced_only_stream_of_the_regular_track_comes_before_that_of_the_sdh_track() {
        let title = bluray(&[VIDEO, ENG_PGS, ENG_PGS_FORCED_ONLY, ENG_PGS, ENG_PGS_FORCED_ONLY]);
        let evidence = facts(vec![
            (1, regular_events()),
            (2, forced_events()),
            (3, sdh_events()),
            (4, times(15, 130.0, 60.0)),
        ]);
        let decision = decide_subtitles(&title, &evidence, &Settings::default());
        assert_eq!(
            decision.kept,
            vec![
                SubtitleTrack { parent: Some(1), ..track(2, SubtitleRole::Forced, Some(20), "flag") },
                track(1, SubtitleRole::Regular, Some(1000), "alignment"),
                track(3, SubtitleRole::Sdh, Some(1200), "alignment"),
            ]
        );
        assert_eq!(decision.dropped, vec![(4, SubtitleDrop::DerivedForcedOnlyUnused)]);
        assert_eq!(decision.set_aside, vec![(2, forced_only_of(1)), (4, forced_only_of(3))]);
        assert_eq!(decision.dialogue_pick, Some(DialoguePick::ForcedParent));
        let forced = &decision.kept[0];
        assert_eq!((forced.name.as_str(), forced.forced, forced.hearing_impaired), ("English (Forced)", true, false));
        assert_eq!((decision.case, decision.confidence), (SubtitleCase::Alignment, 0.85));
    }

    #[test]
    fn the_forced_only_stream_of_the_sdh_track_is_taken_when_the_regular_tracks_one_is_empty() {
```
